# Buxani Care

> > Buxani Care is a comprehensive mental health clinic in Miami, Florida offering therapy, counseling, and psychiatric services for individuals, couples, children, and teenagers.

Buxani Care provides evidence-based mental health treatment including individual therapy, couples counseling, child and teenage therapy, and mindfulness-based interventions across Miami and South Florida. The clinic specializes in treating anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship issues using approaches like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Family Therapy, and Play Therapy.
